找适合自己的起点（四题，可跳过）: Find your starting point (four optional questions)
两端分别放一个 A 类球和一个 B 类球。绕中点转 180° 后，两个位置仍有球: Place one ball of type A at one end and a ball of type B at the other. A 180° turn about the midpoint leaves both positions occupied and swaps the balls. Is this a symmetry of the object when the types matter?
不是，A 和 B 的位置都变了: No. A and B each changed position
是，只要两个位置上仍然有球: Yes. Both positions are still occupied
比较位置时也要比较类型。转动后，原来放 A 的位置现在放的是 B。: Compare the types as well as the positions. After the turn, B sits where A started.
区分操作的阶与不动点: Distinguish operation order from a fixed point
将等边三角形在平面内绕中心转 120°，中心每次都不动。整个转动最少重复几次，才: Rotate an equilateral triangle 120° in its plane about its center. The center stays fixed. What is the fewest number of turns needed to return every point to its starting position?
先跟踪任意一个顶点。它要经过三个顶点才返回，中心每一步都保持原位。: Follow any vertex. It returns after three turns. The center stays in place at every step.
从单位箭头读矩阵: Read a matrix from unit arrows
取向右为 +x、向上为 +y。顺时针转 90° 会把向右的单位箭头转到下方，把向: Take +x to the right and +y upward. A 90° clockwise turn sends the right-pointing unit arrow downward and the upward unit arrow to the right. What are the two matrix columns, in order?
第一列写向右单位箭头的像，第二列写向上单位箭头的像。顺时针转动时，向右的箭头变为: The first column is the image of the right-pointing unit arrow. The second is the image of the upward one. A clockwise turn sends the right-pointing arrow to (0, −1).
确定作用空间再求迹: Identify the action space and find the trace
半转把 (x, y, z) 变成 (x, −y, −z)。在 xy 平面中，矩阵: A half-turn sends (x, y, z) to (x, −y, −z). The matrix in the xy plane has diagonal entries 1, −1. In xyz space the entries are 1, −1, −1. What are the two traces, in order?
迹把所有对角元按原来的正负号相加。xyz 空间比 xy 平面多一个 −1，所以三: Add the diagonal entries with their signs. The extra −1 in xyz space makes the three-dimensional trace one less than the planar trace.
